test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Higher Secondary Level) Official Paper (Held On: 24 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: What is the literacy rate for Scheduled Tribe Population as per the 2011 Census?
solution:
The correct answer is __**59%**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **literacy rate** for the **Scheduled Tribe Population** as per the 2011 Census is **59%**.
 
• The **Scheduled Tribes** are specific indigenous peoples recognized in the Constitution of India.
 
• The census data helps in understanding the educational attainment among different communities and aids in policy formulation.
 
• Efforts have been made by the government to improve literacy rates among Scheduled Tribes through various educational programs and schemes.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **2011 Census** is the **15th National Census of India**.
 
• The data collected during the census includes demographic, social, and economic information.
 
• Literacy is defined as the ability to read and write with understanding in any language.
 
• The government has implemented various schemes like the **National Literacy Mission** to enhance literacy rates.
 
• Special focus is given to marginalized communities, including Scheduled Tribes, to bridge the educational gap.
